Welfare check on stores along Victoria Street East, all clear:

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 / Brent, Isiah (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment: 2 x Vest, 1 x Radio, 1 x Body Camera, 1 x Ops Phone. Guards: Brent, Isiah. All footage/photos involving incidents will be attached following end of shift. (Auror reports have been made.)
Standing by at HQ charging ops phone due to low percentage.
Gearing up and getting ready for patrols.
Commencing patrols heading down towards Commercial Bay; welfare checks on stores along lower Queen St whilst doing so.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare checks on stores along Queen St and McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete. All clear.
Arrived at Gore St; commencing a full sweep of Gore St down to Pocket Park.

Arrived at Pocket Park; welfare check on stores along Gore St, Fort St, Commerce St, and full sweep complete. All clear. Standing by for any nearby response calls as well as maintaining heavy security presence.
Response call from Team 1: a male inside Mountain Warehouse urinating inside their fitting room. Heading to response call.

Arrived at Mountain Warehouse; manager directed us to the POI. Approached the male and informed him he had to depart from the store due to urinating inside their changing room; he complied with no issues. Standing by. (Video on file.)

Whilst on standby overheard yelling and cussing outside JB Hi-Fi by the same individual from Mountain Warehouse. Approached him and did a welfare check, asked him to keep it down as it may escalate and cause a public disturbance. Standing by maintaining security presence. (Video on file.)
Leaving standby area. No issues to report.
Arrived at Durham St East; welfare check on stores within the area complete. No issues.
Arrived at Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq; welfare checks on stores along High St. All clear.
Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq sweep complete. All clear. Standing by maintaining security presence and being aware of any nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area; heading over to Victoria St West.
Arrived at top of Victoria St West; welfare check on stores within the area. All clear. Standing by for any nearby response calls as well as on the look out for any problematic issues or vagrants.
Arrived at Wyndham St / St Patrick's Sq Cathedral; welfare checks on Good 2 Go Convenience. All clear.
St Patrick's Sq sweep. All clear.
Response call from Team 1: a female blasting her music and making a disturbance to businesses outside BNZ lower Queen St.
Arrived at BNZ lower Queen St; female had already left the premises. Standing by on the look out for her in case she returns.
Team 1 informed us of route changeover; Team 2 heading upper Queen St. Heading back to HQ for combined 10-minute break.
Heading up Queen St; welfare checks on stores whilst doing so.
Arrived at Aotea Sq; welfare checks on stores on upper Queen St. All clear.
Aotea Sq sweep complete. No issues.
Arrived at top of Victoria St West; welfare checks on stores within the area. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria St West; welfare checks on stores within the area. All clear. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants and maintaining a visible security presence.
Arrived back at HQ for debrief with Afternoon shift.
Commencing patrols; arrived at Lorne St; commencing a full sweep down towards Auckland Library with welfare checks whilst doing so.
Arrived at Auckland Library; welfare checks on Lorne St stores. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Wellesley St East; standing by maintaining a visible presence as well as being aware of any nearby response calls.
Arrived at Elliot St; welfare checks on Elliot Stables. All clear. Standing by.

Heading down towards Darby St; welfare check on Celines, Pizza Club, Lumi Cafe, Domino's, Tandoori. 2 vagrants sitting outside Celines; informed them they had to move along and they complied. Standing by in case they return. (Video on file.)
Standing by outside Localito for any nearby response calls as well as making our presence visible.
Heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift — Team A (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Arrived at HQ gearing up and being briefed.
Deploying out now. Team A (us) taking lower and Team B taking upper.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Custom St after welfare checks on Starbucks, Mecca, Farmers down to Swarovski. All clear.
Response call from Mirrou: a female who stole a black jacket, last seen walking into Mountain Warehouse.

Arrived at response location; scoped the area for 30 mins, unable to find the POI. Met another Prestige guard on foot searching for a male individual wearing all black who punched someone and ran off. Description of the assault POI: all black with Nike shoes with yellow stripes on the side.

Approached by a council worker who asked us to keep an eye out for a POI. He has been trespassed from the Library and is armed with a wooden sword; believed to be schizophrenic. (Photo provided.) Standing by for security presence.
Heading back towards the office to do handover with B Team.
Arrived and completed handover. Checking on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks on Starbucks to Yoyoso. All clear. Heading towards Elliot St, then Darby St, then the office.
Elliot St all clear. Heading towards Darby St.
Heading to office to charge the ops phone quickly.
Received a call from Cotton On: 2 girls stealing and running out of the store.
Retrieved the items outside of our HQ. Heading to return the items. (Photo provided.)
Items costed $89.99. Retrieved a photo from the staff as well. (Photos provided.)
Heading on patrol towards Aotea Square.
All clear, heading towards Aotea Square:
Yogurt Story, 24 Yes Convenience, and Civic Theater all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.

Aotea Square full sweep. All clear. No issues. Standing by for security presence.
Library area all clear and same for Lorne St. Heading through High St.
High St all clear. No issues. Heading through O'Connell St.
O'Connell St and Freyberg Square all clear. Checking on Chancery Square.
Chancery Square all clear. Spoke to members of the public asking for directions to the port. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards the office to charge the ops phone.
Arrived at the office to charge the ops phone (on 13%). (Photo provided.) Picking up manager Ahmid from the bottom.
Assisted with bringing items upstairs and spoke with him about work. Continuing with patrol.
Arrived at the corner of Federal and Victoria St; commencing welfare checks.
Welfare checks on Hell's Pizza, Fiddler, both 77 Convenience Stores and Kebab Time. Standing by for security presence.
Arrived at Wyndham St; checking on Cathedral area.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading down Wyndham St towards Queen St.
Heading towards the office to have break.
Arrived at the office. Having break.
Break over. Standing by for shift handover.
One of our guards forgot his bank card at Localito. Going to let him know.
Guard got his bank card back; commencing handover.

Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu. No issues.
Response call to Curio Bar due to a disturbance; individual blocking entrance.
Police arrived. 23:20 — they found a pipe on the individual and arrested him. No further issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete. All clear. Heading back up Queen St towards Bar101.
Saw an individual intoxicated; managed to help him catch an Uber. On standby till Uber arrives.
Uber arrived; no further issues. On standby at Bar101 showing presence.
Two males seem to be out looking for trouble; one has his face covered with a blue bandana. (Photos on file.) Heading out to the Viaduct.
Full sweep Viaduct. All clear. Welfare check on guards at Lulas, Danny's and marina. No issues. Heading back to Bar101.
Bar101 closed; Elliot St / Darby St all clear. No issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete. All clear.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield. No issues.
Full sweep Lorne St / High St. All clear.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St. All clear.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark. No issues.
Full sweep Federal St / St Patricks Cathedral. All clear.
